config.author: Rahul Kumar Singh; implemented by ML improvement engineer
config.purpose: Build one genuinely trained, unvalidated logistic prototype from permitted development data; diagnose missing training support without changing the frozen baseline.
config.prior_information: Before this recipe was committed, a read-only support audit found 12 mature rows and 4 positives over 2015-2020, but zero mature rows in both registered fit folds. No prototype performance was inspected.

fitting.selection: Exactly one fixed recipe; never compare fit-set performance to historical-opened metrics.

config.labels: Existing frozen model hypotheses plus official recall dates. No human labels, new model-generated labels, or unknown-label matches.

evaluation.registered_folds: Preserve A: fit through 2016/validate 2017-2018; B: fit through 2018/validate 2019-2020. Unsupported folds remain unsupported.
evaluation.acceptance: Not acceptance-eligible. This full-development fit has no untouched permitted evaluation set and does not satisfy the frozen Phase 2 selection rule.

config.review_queue: All other_unclear development complaint IDs in date/ID order; human label and reviewer fields remain blank. No raw text copied and no human review performed.
config.claims: Trained prototype only; no better-model, calibrated-risk, semantic-accuracy or improved-score claim. Existing dashboard values remain unchanged.
